mechanism: Both drugs are renally eliminated and colchicine is a substrate for P-glycoprotein; ceftazidime may increase colchicine levels through competition for renal tubular secretion, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely and consider colchicine dose reduction if eGFR <60 mL/min; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for colchicine toxicity signs.
